summary: Promote the BrewMind companion contract from a 'working reference' to canonical governed state under the workflows surface.
rationale: docs/companion-agent/brewmind-companion-contract.md is the behavioral backbone for all BrewMind work — it defines abstention rules, evidence tiers, the approval ceremony, lane system, and humane purpose. CLAUDE.md references it as '(working reference — not yet canonical governed state)'. Until this is promoted, the most consequential behavioral contract can drift without triggering the governance gate. The workflows surface already has a brewmind-companion-contract-ref.json stub that points to the working doc — upgrading it to canonical makes the reference authoritative and prevents silent rewrites.
proposed_diff_summary: 1. Copied companion contract to users/cici/governed-state/workflows/companion-contract.md with canonical status header. 2. Updated brewmind-companion-contract-ref.json canonical_source to point to governed path. 3. Updated CLAUDE.md companion defaults link to canonical path. 4. Added companion-contract.md to surface-map.json workflows canonical_files.
decision_notes: Xavier approved. Applied: companion-contract.md created in governed-state/workflows/, ref updated, CLAUDE.md updated, surface-map.json updated.
